title: Understanding Model Complexity
text: When we talk about model complexity, we're referring to how flexible a model is in fitting the data. A more complex model can fit the training data very closely, but what might be a downside of this?

title: Exploring Variance
text: Variance in a model refers to how much the model's predictions change when using different training data. Can you think of how model complexity might affect variance?

title: Bias in Models
text: Bias is the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. How might decreasing model complexity affect bias?
